**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

The first face of the company. Owns the public-facing website and the visual
identity around it — brand system, marketing collateral, deck and one-pager
polish, social and event assets. We need someone who can take the narrative
we've built and give it a look that feels like the living-media era we're
describing, not a standard startup site.

## What You'll Do

- Public website — design and build (or hand off build-ready) the site that
  introduces Infinite Spaces
- Visual identity — a coherent brand system: type, color, motion, imagery
- Collateral — investor deck polish, one-pagers, event and social assets

## What We're Looking For

a portfolio with shipped brand work and a point of view; comfortable
moving fast on a contract and handing off clean, reusable assets.

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
